recalled_knowledge.item: LZ SR1 exposure: 60 live days x 5.5 t fiducial = 0.90 t yr
SR1 g1 = 0.114 phd/photon (SR3 0.110), so S1c = 600 phd ~ 260 keV in SR1
SR1 NREFT search reported no NR-band-like events at high S1c (limits only)
LUX 2021 EFT: 311.2 live days, 3.35e4 kg d = 0.092 t yr
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (live days certain from the LZ bibliography title)

failed_or_abandoned: Full-grid WimPyDD run (0.5 keV steps, 8 delta values, 5 L10 masses) exceeded the 600 s foreground limit twice (about 0.3 s per O1 call, about 1 s per q-dependent L10 call); replaced by reduced grids (0.5/2 keV, delta = 0-250 keV own, 300/350 from P035), per-item caching and P012's L10 spectra (identical shape to an own 200 GeV spectrum, constant ratio to 4 significant figures).
Own delta = 350 keV spectrum cross-check against P005 dropped for time (P005 normalisation re-verified by integration instead, 0.9996-1.0003).
First likelihood implementation returned NaN for archival sets with zero acceptance (0 x log 0); fixed by dropping zero-exposure terms.
